'''Picutorion''' was a planet which rebelled against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]].

[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] Sergeant Major [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] was involved in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Raid on Picutorion|assault]] on the world, which forced the Rebels to evacuate. Commodore [[Bevven]] was stationed on the planet and in charge of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] used in the attack; the ground forces were commanded by [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]] [[Theol Drost]].

[[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] Agent [[Mar Barezz]] recommended to Drost and Bevven to sacrifice Captain [[Ganig]] and Sergeant [[Stecker]] in the assault, since both men were suspected Rebel sympathizers, despite being heroes of the [[Battle of Sagma]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]'' unequivocally placed the planet Picutorion in Kwymar sector, but a Senex Lord named [[Vensell Picutorion]] appears in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], suggesting that [[Barbara Hambly]] might have intended the planet to be in [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].

Since Kwymar and Picutorion are shown on opposite sides of the galaxy on recent maps, possibly explanations for the paradox would include the family giving their name to the distant planet, or originating there before moving to Senex.
